newsitem.title: USA: Sara Lee's Coach mulls Mark Cross options.
newsitem.headline: Sara Lee's Coach mulls Mark Cross options.

text.p: Sara Lee Corp said Monday its Coach division is exploring business options for its Mark Cross leather goods business, including a possible sale.
"In February, employees were told that Coach was exploring alternatives for the Mark Cross business and that sale was one of those alternatives," said Sara Lee spokesman Jeffrey Smith.

Sara Lee's Coach and Mark Cross leather divisions are managed as a group with Coach overseeing the Mark Cross operation. The group generated about $500 million in sales for the year ended July 1, 1996.
Sara Lee has owned New York-based Mark Cross since 1993. Mark Cross makes handbags, wallets, briefcases and other leather accessories.
No developements have been announced since the February advisory to employees, Smith told Reuters.
Shares of Sara Lee were trading up 1/2 to 42-1/8.
